ui.extra.cacheClean:
1. Confirm whether the search history in the game has been opened, and if the error "User authentication expired" still appears, try the following steps 
2. Close the game window of Zenless Zone Zero 
3. Click the "Open Web Cache Folder" button above to open the "Cache" folder 
4. Delete the "Cache_Data" folder 
5. Start the Zenless Zone Zero game and open the search history page in the game 
6. Close this dialog and click the "Update Data" button
ui.extra.findCacheFolder: If the "Open cache folder" button does not respond, you can manually find the game's web cache folder. The directory is "Your game installation path/ZenlessZoneZero_Data/webCaches/Cache/"

ui.analysis.fortune.hint: Percentile = share of players pulling under the same rules who did better than you.
ui.analysis.fortune.speedDetail: {n} × S-rank in {t} pulls (incl. {c} pulls of current pity)
ui.analysis.fortune.note: Uses community rate models (agents 0.6%, +6% per pull from 74, hard pity 90; W-Engines and Bangboo 1%, +6% from 65, hard pity 80, matching the published 1.6% and 2.0% consolidated rates). Banners are matched by time, using data from hoyo-gacha (BWIKI). Worst/best banner are picked by pulls spent beyond (or below) what their rate-ups should cost; the tier is that banner's own efficiency. Tiers: top 5% Blessed, 5–25% Lucky, 25–75% Average, 75–95% Unlucky, bottom 5% Cursed.

Pulls = what each rate-up copy cost, including the S-rank lost before its guarantee; other copies add to the mindscape only. Gifts and exchanges aren't in the signal history, so record them with + on the card.
